entities.name: Query 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase E1
observations: 768 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 85.73 kDa and theoretical pI 6.43.
Has Pfam 2-oxogl_dehyd_N at residues 46–85, E1_dh at 252–557, and Transket_pyr at 639–766.

Shows 100% identity and full query coverage to curated Dictyostelium discoideum Q54JE4 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase, with additional ~48–50% identity over ~94% query coverage to curated Saccharomyces and Schizosaccharomyces homologs.
Best-supported function is the E1 component of the mitochondrial 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex, EC 1.2.4.2.
Reaction: oxidative decarboxylation of 2-oxoglutarate with transfer of the succinyl group to protein-bound lipoamide, producing CO2 and succinyldihydrolipoyl-protein.
Reference annotations support thiamine diphosphate and Mg2+ dependence, mitochondrial matrix localization, and participation in the tricarboxylic acid cycle.
Functional assignment is supported primarily by strong homology and domain architecture; exact organism and targeting/processing state are not established from sequence alone.
Sequence is moderately hydrophilic and near-neutral overall: GRAVY -0.426, predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -4.6, instability index 36.6.
